label: High Distress and Loneliness
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively higher loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms than other groups in the dataset.
demographic_anchor: Female, graduate education or above, and more than 5 hours.
behavior_markers: Reports elevated loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure.
Shows higher depressive symptom levels on the PHQ-9.
Shows higher anxiety symptom levels on the GAD-7.
Represents a training-split subgroup of 165 respondents.

label: Lower distress, highly educated male profile
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: Male, graduate education or above, with a 1–3 hour anchor characteristic.
behavior_markers: Lower UCLA-8 loneliness score on average (mean 0.766)
Lower PHQ-9 depressive symptom level on average (mean 0.327)
Very low GAD-7 anxiety symptom level on average (mean 0.086)
tone: Relatively stable, low-distress, and emotionally well-adjusted overall.

label: Profile 2: Lonely but low distress
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively higher loneliness while showing lower average depressive and anxiety symptoms. This suggests a group that feels socially disconnected but does not, on average, show strong broader emotional distress on the measured symptom scales.
demographic_anchor: Typically anchored by female respondents with graduate-level education or above and 1-3 hours in the referenced time-use category.
behavior_markers: Reports relatively elevated loneliness compared with other profiles
Shows lower average depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9
Shows lower average anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7
Represents a pattern of social disconnection without correspondingly high general symptom burden
tone: Socially disconnected, but otherwise comparatively emotionally stable on measured depression and anxiety indicators.
